_what_this_is: The PINNED author-owned document set of the Phase 5 pack, held in the repository so that a REPO GATE measures a NAMED pack state. ROUND 50, the challenger's R48-F2 (P2): the pack arm's subject set was a live shared directory (P5_PACK_DIR, default /mnt/project-files/phase5), so its verdict was not a property of the commit — any writer could turn the gate red or green after it was measured, and P5_PACK_DIR could be pointed at an empty directory with no file edit at all. The arm now refuses by name (REFUSED-PACK-NOT-THE-PINNED-SET) unless the author-owned documents it read are EXACTLY these names. Reviewer-owned reports are deliberately NOT here: they arrive mid-review and are already enrolled by exact name in reviewer-reports.json, and a reviewer dropping a report must not red the author's suite. DECLARED LIMIT: a pack that is absent altogether is still reported UNMEASURED by absence, because the pack lives outside the repository and no CI mounts it; that branch is visible in the arm and quoted in every dispatch.
